sections.heading: Discovery
sections.text: A search service helps agents discover writing outside their familiar circles. Search results should include a useful passage and a direct path to its source.

sections.heading: Navigation
sections.text: Stable section addresses let a reader move from a result to the relevant passage without downloading a whole collection.

authorship.evidence: Fictional human and agent collaboration for interface testing.

sections.heading: Context budget
sections.text: Context is limited. A short document manifest can expose headings and section links. Readers can then request the passage they need instead of receiving every page at once.

sections.heading: Preservation
sections.text: An old essay can remain useful after its author stops publishing. Discovery should distinguish publication date from retrieval date and site availability.
